title: Family Traits
description: Learn how child classes inherit magical traits and superpowers from parent classes!

content.value: Imagine you are designing a superhero video game. You have a general `Hero` class with traits like `name` and actions like `run()`. Now you want to create a `FlyingHero` class. Instead of re-writing `name` and `run()`, you can make `FlyingHero` INHERIT (or adopt) them from `Hero`!
We specify the Parent class in parentheses when defining the Child class.
Even though `Dog` does not have an `eat` method written inside it, it inherits it from `Animal`! You can call `dog.eat()` and it works perfectly.

my_dog = Dog("Buddy")
my_dog.eat()   # Prints: Buddy is eating!
my_dog.bark()  # Prints: Buddy says Woof!

practice.question: Create a Dog object named 'rover' (which inherits from Animal) and call its rover.eat() method!

quiz.question: What does a child class do in inheritance?
options: Adopts all attributes and methods from the parent class.
quiz.explain: A child class automatically gets (inherits) all the attributes and methods of its parent, then can add its own.

quiz.question: How do you define a class 'Car' that inherits from 'Vehicle'?
quiz.explain: You put the parent's name in parentheses: `class Car(Vehicle):` means Car inherits from Vehicle.
